rules.description: Long browser freshness only for successful hashed asset responses
rules.expression: (http.host in {"tournstack.com" "www.tournstack.com"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/versioned/") and http.response.code eq 200)

rules.description: Never retain missing, redirected or failed versioned asset responses
rules.expression: (http.host in {"tournstack.com" "www.tournstack.com"} and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/versioned/") and http.response.code ne 200)

rules.description: Website browser protections; local prepared configuration, activate separately after review

content-security-policy.value: base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self' https://script.google.com https://script.googleusercontent.com https://*.googleusercontent.com

rules.description: Strict CSP candidate, observation only until real vendor and nested form checks pass
rules.expression: (http.host in {"tournstack.com" "www.tournstack.com"} and ssl and (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".html")))
